programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: To celebrate Refugee Week, Adam invites tennis legend Jelena Dokic and CommUnity Construction founder Hedayat Osyan to share their treasured tastes.

programs.title: Sergio Perera's Destination Noosa
programs.desc: Michelin-trained chef and world traveller, Sergio Perera, takes to Noosa on the Sunshine coast where he explores the plentiful food scene of the region.

programs.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programs.desc: In the season finale, the home bakers take on the most challenging and personal bake of the entire competition-telling their baking story through four delectable dessert chapters.

programs.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
programs.desc: What does a chef eat when he's at home? For Victor it's claypot rice. It's a one-pot dish that's soft, crispy, chewy and savoury all at once. Victor shares his best tips to create your own!

programs.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programs.desc: On a tour of the Victorian High Country, one of the great food centres of Australia, Adam is on a mission to track down all the ingredients necessary for the perfect picnic.

programs.title: Flat Out Food
programs.desc: Saskatchewan produces the second-most amount of honey in Canada. Jenn learns about bees, how to make mead from honey and how honey can be used to elevate a dish.

programs.title: On Country Kitchen
programs.desc: Mark and Derek host a dinner party at Silos Estate to thank everyone. They visit a cattle farm and collect native berries and bimbalas with Noel Butler.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.sub_title: Que Pasta: Mexican Street Corn Pasta
programs.desc: Rachael is going to show us how to take your favourite summer staple of grilled corn on the cob to a whole new level by combining it with spicy chili and cotija cheese.

programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Matt makes chai spiced biscotti; Tobie makes wafu spaghetti carbornara; Laura makes cavatelli cacio e pepe.

programs.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programs.desc: Lidia shows us that dishes we typically eat out, can easily be made at home, with some practice.

programs.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programs.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halacho to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. They begin at the local market to source ingredients.

programs.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programs.desc: Join Silvia in her kitchen, where she loves nothing more than share what she has learned from her family and friends, so you too can master the beauty of simple Italian home cooking.
